name: More Al'Aketh Ears
objectiveText: Collect 10 Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears from the Al'Aketh in Shadowgale Forest, the Shine of Akir, or Gustberry Lowlands and return them to Vayn Moonclaw in Shadowgale Forest. Al'Aketh Cultist's Ear  ( 5 )

comments.body: It appears that this was heavily nerfed in todays patch.[b] I only got 200 rep for turning in 5 ears[/b], which also had a lower than 24% drop rate. (Mine was about 10%). This is a HUGE increase in the time investment.
replies: Doing all quests no longer takes you to honoured either, it didn't even get me halfway.

comments.body: So repetition for an additional 5 ears (first turn-in of blue "?") gave me 1000 Nightclaw Druids rep and brought me to Friendly with them.
replies: You can do this all the way up to Exalted, great source for Linen Cloth for your tailor as well (at the Shrine of Akir at least)

comments.body:
I am honored with this dude and he has a ton of +1 patterns to buy at like 9silver 90copper 
all the gear is +1 stat (agil\str\spirit) kind of okay - but leather working has better patterns
